assets.caption: APPENDIX 9 Pipe Support Selection Flowchart
assets.notes: Full-page decision flowchart for pipe support selection. Decision nodes include: PIPE INSULATED, SOLID INSULATION, CORROSIVE ENVIRONMENT, PIPE CARBON STEEL, PAINT NEEDED, HIGH FORCES/MOMENTS, TEMP >400 DEGREE C, FLUID TEMP BELOW AMBIENT, PIPE SLOPING, PIPE SIZE ABOVE DN650, >=CS SCHED 20 > SC SCHED 100. Terminal boxes: SEE DEP 30.48.00.31-Gen., SPECIAL DESIGNED CLAMPED SUPPORT, CLAMPED SUPPORT, SPECIAL DESIGNED WELDED SUPPORT, WELDED SUPPORT, DIRECT ON SUPPORTING BEAM.
